card.name: Words just before a punctuation character
card.fires_on: Small linking words (by, with, an, or, a, of) in technical text that is about to name a punctuation character such as a hyphen, minus, plus, backslash or comma. It also fires on spaces before dates.

modes.label: Before a punctuation mark
modes.description: A linking word right before a named symbol like hyphen, dash or minus.
modes.example: with each part separated<< by>> a hyphen.

modes.label: Before a date number
modes.description: A space before the day number in a date.
